answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply orders the problems as 'Fix before launch (members will fail or get the wrong result)' (items 1-4), then 'Fix next', then 'Smaller things', and its 'Suggested order' starts with items 1 and 2 as 'the riskiest'. It names what it could not check: 'I didn't test with VoiceOver or TalkBack, or in Safari's date picker, so a real run on an iPhone and an Android phone is still worth doing.'

mapping.title: Closed days can be picked and are refused only at confirm
mapping.reason: The tool page 'offers all 21 days'. Friday 16 Oct is accepted, and only the confirm button answers 'The library is closed on Friday 16 October…', with no link and the tool page as the only way back. That is D06: a closed day the calendar accepts, refused three steps later.

mapping.title: Pick-up date asked for a second time in the basket
mapping.reason: 'The basket then asks again, separately, for a pick-up session', and the fix is 'ask once … carry that choice through so the basket just shows it'. That is D23: the member enters the day already chosen on the tool page a second time, in another form, and can choose a different one.

mapping.title: Tool-page day and basket session never reconciled
mapping.reason: 'The two choices are never checked against each other', and in the change-session case the confirm page shows 'pick up Saturday 17 October' beside the session 'Wednesday 21 October'. That is D15, down to its own example.

mapping.title: Days before a tool is back can be chosen
mapping.reason: 'The calendar also lets you pick days before a tool is back (the sander isn't available until 21 Oct, but 10 Oct can be chosen)'. The fix offers only days on or after 'Available from'. That is D14.

mapping.title: Hidden ten-minute hold leaves the basket stuck
mapping.reason: The hold runs ten minutes from the first tool and is 'never shown' (the basket says only 'Items are held for you while you finish'). Afterwards Continue says 'Something went wrong. Try again.' every time. That is D10. The point that retrying never helps is part of the same lapsed hold.

mapping.title: Double-tapping 'Confirm reservation' makes two reservations
mapping.reason: The button 'stays active during that wait', there is 'no visible sign that anything is happening', and one double tap produced 'FT-4471 and FT-4472'. That is D12. 'Do the same for Continue on the basket page' only widens the fix, so it stays with this item.

mapping.title: Truncated names make the two drills look the same
mapping.reason: 'At 375 px, every tool name is cut to one line', so 'Cordless drill 18 V, co…' appears twice and the one-battery and two-battery drills can't be told apart. The fix is 'let names wrap'. That is D03.

mapping.title: Search box below all ten cards on a phone
mapping.reason: 'The search box is about 2,100 px down, after all ten cards', the focus order 'doesn't match what's on screen', and Filters is 'an icon only'. The fix is 'put search first everywhere'. That is D01: the list comes before the form at phone width, the filter button is icon-only, and focus runs against the visual order. The review places the focus mismatch on desktop, but it is the same search-versus-results order with the same fix.

mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' badge fails contrast
mapping.reason: 'Green text #2f7d4a on #1d2622 has a contrast of 3.07:1, against a required 4.5:1' matches D04's colours and ratio. The note that the badge's tint equals the card, so 'available soon' is the least noticeable badge, comes from the same dark-mode badge colours (the fix is '--color-ok: #8fd1a8 and a real tint'), so it belongs to this item.

mapping.title: Basket sessions listed in reverse order
mapping.reason: On a phone the sessions 'run 28 Oct at the top down to 10 Oct at the bottom', and 'Keyboard and screen-reader order is the reverse' (row-reverse, wrap-reverse). That is D11.

mapping.title: A search with no matches gives no feedback
mapping.reason: Searching 'hammer' 'leaves all 10 tools on screen, and nothing is announced'. The fix is to show 'No tools match …'. That is D02.

mapping.title: Multi-word search misses a tool that exists
mapping.reason: The review shows 'drill with two batteries' matching nothing although the two-battery drill is in the library, and asks to 'match each word separately'. A member who types what they need in their own words (here the very drill the main scenario turns on) gets nothing from the search and is left scanning ten cards in which the two drills look alike. The ground truth covers only the missing no-results message (D02), not how the search matches.

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' gives only a 1.2-second toast
mapping.reason: 'The toast disappears too fast to read on a phone, and there's no clear next step except the Basket (1) link'. The fix is a lasting message. The harm it names is the brief feedback after the press, not a belief that the tool is already reserved, so it maps to D07 rather than D26.

mapping.title: Loan-length dropdown traps keyboard users
mapping.reason: 'Tab and Escape just cycle between the options; I tested this', and clicking outside does not close the list either. The fix is a native select. That is D09: a custom listbox that can be left only by choosing an option.

mapping.title: Membership and phone number formats too strict
mapping.reason: The form rejects 'ft-01234' and '07700 900 123', and the fix is to accept any capitalisation and any spacing. Both examples are in D17.

mapping.title: 'Change' returns to the basket with no session selected
mapping.reason: 'Change' 'goes to the basket with no session pre-selected', and the fix is 'pass slot back'. That is D13. The suggestion to rename the link 'Change session' is part of the fix for the same link, so it stays with this item.

mapping.title: 'Change' loses the name and number already typed
mapping.reason: 'Change' 'loses the name and number already typed', and the fix is to keep the details in sessionStorage. That is D22.

mapping.title: Find page scrolls sideways at 200% zoom
mapping.reason: The find page is 346 px wide 'because of minmax(330px, 1fr)', and the fix is 'minmax(min(330px,100%),1fr)'. Those are D05's 330 px grid columns and its 346 px page. The remark that the other pages are 259 px wide in the same viewport is part of the same reflow item.

mapping.title: Basket still shows 'Basket (1)' after confirming
mapping.reason: 'After confirming, the basket still shows Basket (1)', and the fix is to clear it on the done page. That is D18.

mapping.title: Reservation number looks like a membership number
mapping.reason: 'FT-4471' uses the same prefix as 'FT-01234'. A member collecting a tool holds two codes that both read 'FT-' plus digits, so they can quote or show the wrong one at the desk and the volunteer then looks for the wrong record. The risk is minor but real at the step where the reservation is used, and it is not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Three-tool limit stated but not enforced
mapping.reason: 'The maximum three tools rule is stated but not enforced' is D21: the basket accepts more tools than the find page says are allowed.

mapping.title: Done page reads the tool name twice
mapping.reason: 'Screen readers hear the tool name twice on the done page, because of the hidden #c-tool copy' is D24.

mapping.title: Sticky Reserve bar covers the footer phone number
mapping.reason: The sticky Reserve bar 'covers the footer phone number at the bottom of the tool page', and the fix is bottom padding equal to the bar's height. D08 is this fixed bar with nothing keeping the page clear of it, and it names this phone case: 'the footer and the desk phone number sit under the bar'.
